fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: The document this rule applies to.

fields.label: Attachment Type
fields.description: The kind of file required or offered on that document.

fields.label: Required
fields.description: Block saving/submitting until a file of this type is attached. Unticked: the type is only offered in the checklist.

fields.label: Required On
fields.description: Save: checked on every save after the first. Submit: checked only when submitting.

fields.label: Lock After Submit
fields.description: After submit, attachments on this document type can't be deleted, renamed, re-typed or made private/public. New files can still be added. Cancel lifts the lock.
Python expression on doc, e.g. doc.grand_total > 1000. Empty means always.
